page.overview:
Who is Agent Helix?

Agent Helix is a character in the IDW G.I. Joe Real American Hero comics.

Agent Helix is a former victim of child trafficking, who is possessed of a unique set of strategic and war fighting skills... and who has become the Joes' deadliest secret weapon.

Agent Helix (real name classified) is a covert operations officer for the G.I. Joe team. She is an expert marksman with advanced martial arts training. 's an Olympic-class gymnast and uses her distinctive "Whirlwind attack" to deliver overpowering combinations of kicks and firepower to Cobra agents. Has the ability to identify and solve complex physical calculations at a rate that some consider extremely spooky. To her, everything has a data set, like miles left before a car will run out of gas or ammo count in the bad guy's guns, etc. To Duke and Hawk, this ability is called "Total Organic Battlefield Awareness".
